points.description: Setup: labels the data as positive/negative classes (e.g. +1/-1) and initializes the weights (randomly or otherwise).

Update rule inside a loop over the data points: if a point is misclassified (e.g. <w,x> <= 0 for the correctly signed/label-adjusted input), update the weights by adding eta times the (label-signed) input, w = w + eta*x. Equivalent formulations of the perceptron update rule are accepted.
Repeats over epochs until a stopping criterion is met (weights no longer change / no misclassifications); may note convergence is guaranteed because the data is linearly separable.
